record.paper_title: Open Problems in Quantum Information Theory
record.original_question: For each fixed dimension bound d, does there exist a number p_d > 0 such that additivity of minimal output Rényi entropy, S^p_min(Φ ⊗ Ω) = S^p_min(Φ) + S^p_min(Ω), holds uniformly for all channels Φ: M_{d'} → M_{d'} with d' ≤ d either throughout p_d < p < 1 when p_d < 1 or throughout 1 < p < p_d when p_d > 1?

evidence.quote: Then (24) can be rewritten as Spmin(Φ ⊗ Ω) = Spmin(Φ) + Spmin(Ω).

Conjecture 17. For any fixed integer d there is a pd > 0 such that either (i) pd < 1 and (26) holds whenever Φ : Md′ ↦→ Md′, d′ ≤ d and pd < p < 1, or (ii) pd > 1 and (26) holds whenever Φ : Md′ ↦→ Md′, d′ ≤ d and 1 < p < pd.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a positive integer n, let M_n denote the algebra of n×n complex matrices. A quantum channel Φ : M_n → M_m is a completely positive trace-preserving linear map. For p > 0 with p ≠ 1, the minimal output Rényi p-entropy of a channel Φ is defined by
  S^p_min(Φ) = inf_ρ (1/(1−p)) log Tr[Φ(ρ)^p],
where the infimum is taken over density matrices ρ (positive semidefinite matrices of trace 1) on the input space. For two channels Φ and Ω, one says that Rényi p-additivity holds for the pair if
  S^p_min(Φ ⊗ Ω) = S^p_min(Φ) + S^p_min(Ω).

Question. Does the following statement hold? For every fixed positive integer d there exists a real number p_d > 0 such that exactly one of the following two cases occurs:
 (i) p_d < 1, and S^p_min(Φ ⊗ Ω) = S^p_min(Φ) + S^p_min(Ω) holds for every pair of channels Φ : M_{d'} → M_{d'} and Ω : M_{d''} → M_{d''} with d', d'' ≤ d, and for every p with p_d < p < 1; or
 (ii) p_d > 1, and the same equality holds whenever d', d'' ≤ d and 1 < p < p_d.

Decide whether such a threshold p_d exists for each fixed d.
artifact.status_search_result: Known counterexamples to additivity of minimal output Rényi p-entropy (Hayden–Winter for p>1; Cubitt–Harrow–Leung–Montanaro–Winter and subsequent work for p<1, with violations in intervals such as (1−p₀,1) for p₀≈0.2855, and recent constructions for all p>1) all rely on input dimensions growing with the desired closeness to p=1. For each fixed input dimension bound d, no proof or disproof of dimension-uniform Rényi additivity in a one-sided neighborhood of p=1 is reported, so the conjecture appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Counterexamples to Additivity of Minimum Output p-Rényi Entropy for p Close to 0
status_evidence.snippet: Explicit channels with non-multiplicative minimum output rank; numerics indicate non-additivity for p ≲ 0.11.
status_evidence.claim: Violations near p=0 require specific (growing) dimensional constructions, leaving fixed-d behavior unsettled.

status_evidence.title: The maximal p-norm multiplicativity conjecture is false
status_evidence.snippet: Hayden–Winter showed non-additivity of minimum output Rényi p-entropy for all p>1.
status_evidence.claim: Counterexamples for p>1 use high-dimensional random constructions, not refuting the fixed-d uniform conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Constructive counterexamples to additivity of minimum output Rényi entropy for all p>1
status_evidence.snippet: Provides constructive counterexamples for all p>1.
status_evidence.claim: Recent constructions still use growing dimensions; the fixed-dimension threshold conjecture is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: The minimum Rényi entropy output of a quantum channel is locally additive
status_evidence.snippet: Local additivity result for minimum Rényi entropy output.
status_evidence.claim: Partial positive results exist but do not establish the dimension-uniform threshold conjecture.
